what: *** THE METHOD, and it is reusable on any film ***
detail: Each thumbnail was drawn to a 32x24 canvas and its mean luminance taken. *** Filming target boards read 16-30; ordinary pages read 140-156. *** A threshold of 60 separates them with nothing in between. Scanned at *** stride 2 *** - enough, because a boundary is a FIN/START pair of two consecutive images, so one of the pair is always odd.
why it is useful: *** 1,604 thumbnails measured in three calls, with no session and no screenshots. *** The public thumbnail endpoint does the whole job. *** Contact sheets find boards by eye; this finds them by number ***, and on a 3,208-image reel that is the difference between a morning and three calls.

*** So the reel holds roughly eighteen items ***, where this archive had identified three. Where two numbers are given, they are the *** FIN DEL ITEM *** and the *** start *** board of the next, sometimes with a blank leaf between.

detail: *** Image 00004: volumen 1 = Libros 2 y 334 *** (filmed 29 Mar 2006). *** Image 02724: FIN DEL ITEM, Libro 107. *** *** Image 02725: volumen 15 = Libro 256 *** (filmed 5 Apr 2006), which runs to the end of the film and holds *** MARIA LLERENA at image 02771. ***
why it is useful: *** Three of eighteen. *** Every other board is *** one image load away *** from naming its volumen and its Libro - that is the whole of what remains to finish this map.

what: *** WHY A RELUCTANT NOTE IS OWED HERE ***
why it is useful: *** This archive has now read six images of three thousand two hundred *** , and those six produced Sancho's household with four enslaved people named, two Lerena households with ages, and a Spanish-born Llerena woman heading her own house. *** The padrones are enumerations of the LIVING, with ages and stated birthplaces, and they run earlier than any Uruguayan work here. *** *** Nothing in this archive has a better ratio of unread pages to likely findings. ***

what: *** CORRECTION, SAME DAY: 'EIGHTEEN ITEM BOUNDARIES' OVERSTATES IT ***
detail: The scan finds *** DARK FRAMES ***, and a target board is only one kind of dark frame. *** Image 00127 was predicted to be a title board and is a BLACK BOOK COVER. *** Image 00091 shows only the reel symbol of a *** FIN DEL ITEM *** card, with no title at all.
why it is useful: *** So the eighteen are CANDIDATE boundaries, not confirmed ones ***, and each still costs one look to say what it is. *** Three are confirmed by eye: image 00004 (title board, volumen 1), 02724 (FIN DEL ITEM, Libro 107) and 02725 (title board, volumen 15). *** *** The scan is still worth what it cost *** - it reduced 3,208 images to eighteen places worth looking - *** but it does not identify items, it finds candidates ***, and this file said otherwise for about twenty minutes.

what: *** AND THE RULE I INFERRED DOES NOT HOLD ***
detail: From the confirmed pair at 02724/02725 I inferred that each cluster runs *** FIN, then a blank, then the START board carrying the title ***, so the last image of a cluster would always be the title.
why it is useful: *** Tested on cluster 125-127 and it failed at once *** - 127 is a book cover. *** The inference was made from a single confirmed example and is withdrawn. *** What survives is the list of places to look.
